notes: All five records a round-55 agent returned on the revolving door, filed as returned with one note added to the Mongolian record about a defect in the source page. Two of the five name a private financial employer and so count: Belize and Mongolia, which closes two of the nine places that held only public moves and rendered blank. Zambia was RESOLVED THE OTHER WAY and that is worth as much: the held record was Dr Richard Chembe going from the Bank of Zambia to Investrust Bank, and the missing fact was Investrust's ownership. ZCCM Investments Holdings, which describes itself in its own release as 'State owned ZCCM IH', raised its Investrust stake from 45.4 to 71.4 per cent in 2018, so the state mining holding company was already the largest shareholder when Chembe was appointed. It is filed as a public move and Zambia stays blank, which is the honest outcome rather than a missed one. South Korea stays held: the company's legal name was established as Seoul Money Brokerage Services, Ltd. from its LEI record, but that record names no parent, four searches in English and Korean found no shareholder list, and the appointment year is not stated in the English article either. Silence about ownership is not evidence of private ownership. North Macedonia produced a real finding that was correctly NOT filed: the bank's own CV of Vice Governor Fadil Bajrami says he spent more than five years in managerial positions in the private sector before September 2005, but withholds both the firm and the industry, and a private move not shown to be financial must not be filed with public_move false.

records.people: Marina Laetitia Murillo (Deputy Governor, Monetary and Financial Systems)
records.move: from management positions in the private financial sector (employers not named) back to the Central Bank of Belize as Economist I
records.summary: The Central Bank of Belize's own Office of the Governor page states that Marina Laetitia Murillo began at the Bank as a Research Officer in August 1991, that from 1998 she worked in project management in the non-government sector and in management positions in the private financial sector, and that she returned to the Bank in November 2011 as Economist I, rising to Assistant Manager of the Financial System Development Unit in October 2018 and to Deputy Governor effective 1 September 2022; the outside employers are financial and the page itself characterises them as private, so the private-finance fact comes from the central bank's own published biography rather than from any inference, though the firms are not named.
records.source_title: The Governor - Office of the Governor, Central Bank of Belize

records.people: Khosjargal Undraa (Member of the Supervisory Board)
records.move: from thirteen years at Golomt Bank, then MIG LLC and BPM Mongolia LLC, to Member of the Supervisory Board of the Bank of Mongolia
records.summary: The Bank of Mongolia's own profile page gives Khosjargal Undraa's dated career as branch teller, loan officer and business centre staff at Golomt Bank from 2006 to 2007, product development manager there 2007-2010, branch director 2010-2014, director of channel management 2014-2018 and project director of its business process re-engineering project 2018-2019, then deputy director of MIG LLC 2021-2022 and chief executive of BPM Mongolia LLC from 2022, before joining the central bank's Supervisory Board in 2025; Golomt Bank is a private commercial bank, a fact taken from the bank's own About Us page, which states it was established on 6 March 1995 as a subsidiary company of Bodi International LLC and became a joint-stock company at its 2022 IPO, naming no state shareholder. One caution about the source: the page's visible heading, photo caption and career block all name Khosjargal Undraa, while the page's hidden metadata carries a different person's name, which looks like a template fault; the record follows the visible page.
records.source_title: Khosjargal Undraa, Member of the Supervisory Board - Bank of Mongolia profile

records.people: Enkhjargal Danzanbaljir (Deputy Governor 2007-2010; Member of the Supervisory Board since 2025)
records.move: from Deputy Governor and London representative of the Bank of Mongolia out to the Asian Development Bank, World Bank, AIIB, the International Investment Bank and the state-owned State Bank of Mongolia, and back to the Bank of Mongolia's Supervisory Board
records.summary: The Bank of Mongolia's own profile page gives Enkhjargal Danzanbaljir's dated career as chief economist and adviser to the Governor 2001-2002, resident representative in London 2002-2007, Deputy Governor 2007-2010 and director of the London representative office 2010-2013, then finance and banking adviser at the Asian Development Bank from December 2010, a role at the AIIB in 2015, World Bank consultant in 2016, senior adviser to an EU and GIZ project 2017-2018, Mongolia's director on the board of the intergovernmental International Investment Bank 2021-2022, interim chief executive of Millennium Challenge Corporation Mongolia 2022-2023 and independent board member of the State Bank of Mongolia 2020-2024, before rejoining the central bank's Supervisory Board in 2025; every outside employer named is a multilateral body, a state-owned bank or a donor programme, so no private firm appears and this is recorded as a public move.
records.source_title: Enkhjargal Danzanbaljir, Member of the Supervisory Board - Bank of Mongolia profile

records.people: Dr Richard K. E. Chembe (senior management, Bank of Zambia)
records.move: from senior management positions at the Bank of Zambia and the IMF to Managing Director of Investrust Bank Plc, effective 1 May 2015
records.summary: Investrust Bank Plc's directorate announcement of 16 April 2015 states that Dr Richard K. E. Chembe, who held senior management positions at the Bank of Zambia and the International Monetary Fund and was special assistant for economic and development affairs to Zambia's fourth president, was appointed managing director effective 1 May 2015 subject to Bank of Zambia approval, replacing Mr Friday Ndhlovu who was to retire on 31 May 2015; the hiring employer is NOT private, because ZCCM Investments Holdings Plc, which its own 22 May 2018 release describes as 'State owned ZCCM IH', raised its Investrust stake from 45.4% to 71.4% that year, meaning the Zambian state mining holding company was already the bank's largest shareholder when Chembe was appointed, so this is recorded as a public move and does not evidence a move through private finance.
records.source_title: Investrust Bank PLC Announces Directorate Changes

records.people: Dr Ibrahim L. Stevens (Governor; previously Deputy Governor and Director of Research)
records.move: from about a decade at the Bank of England, on secondment, to Director of Research at the Bank of Sierra Leone 2008-2010 ; from the London School of Economics International Growth Centre and macroeconomic advisory work for Rwanda's Ministry of Finance to Deputy Governor of the Bank of Sierra Leone in July 2014
records.summary: The George Washington University Africa Finance and Trade profile of Dr Ibrahim L. Stevens states that he spent about a decade at the Bank of England working on financial stability and monetary analysis and as senior adviser at its Centre for Central Banking Studies, served as Director of Research at the Bank of Sierra Leone from 2008 to 2010 on secondment from the Bank of England, was Country Programme Director at the London School of Economics International Growth Centre, macroeconomic adviser to Rwanda's Ministry of Finance and Economic Development and head of a German International Cooperation funded project, was appointed Deputy Governor in July 2014 and reappointed for a second five-year term in 2019, became First Deputy Governor under the Bank of Sierra Leone Act 2019 and has been Governor since November 2023; every outside employer named is a central bank, a ministry, a university programme or a donor agency, so no private firm is involved and this is recorded as a public move.
records.source_title: Ibrahim L. Stevens - GWU Africa Finance and Trade Initiative
